## chamadas
- bash (intenção: Verifying size and all citation bounds | comando: cd /home/one/projects/one/ai-guides/protocols/telegram_bots_guide && wc -c 28-performance-and-capacity.md && python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('28-performance-and-capacity.md'); t=p.read_text()
res=pathlib.Path('/tmp/telegram-research'); spec=r'(\d+(?:[,-]\d+)*)'; n=0; bad=0
for span in re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`', t):
    d=re.fullmatch(rf'(bots/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.md)(?::{spec})?', span)
    r=re.fullmatch(rf'(python-telegram-bot|aiogram|pyTelegramBotAPI|grammY|telegraf|gramio|teloxide|carapax|tgbotapi-rs)/(\S+/\S+?)(?::{spec})?', span)
    if d: f=res/'pages'/('api/'+d.group(1).rsplit('/',1)[-1] if '/api/methods/' in d.group(1) or '/api/types/' in d.group(1) else d.group(1).replace('/','_')+'.md'); s=d.group(2)
    elif r: f=res/'repos'/r.group(1)/r.group(2); s=r.group(3)
    else: continue
    n+=1
    if not f.exists(): print('MISSING',span,f); bad+=1; continue
    lines=f.read_bytes().count(b'\n')+1
    if s:
        for part in s.split(','):
            a,b=(part.split('-',1)+[None])[:2] if '-' in part else (part,part)
            if int(a)<1 or int(b)>lines: print('BAD',span,part,lines); bad+=1
print('citations',n,'bad',bad,'md.md refs',t.count('.md.md:'),'urls',len(re.findall(r'https://',t)))
PY)
